column1: How many kilometres of federal roads are under construction or repair?
column2: More than 2,700 km of highways and major roads, according to the Presidency's third-anniversary statement (29 May 2026).
column3: Better roads cut travel time and transport costs, which feed into food prices.

column1: What is the Lagos–Calabar Coastal Highway?
column2: A flagship highway linking eight coastal states: Lagos, Ogun, Ondo, Delta, Bayelsa, Rivers, Akwa Ibom and Cross River. About ₦2.23tn has been spent on it so far.
column3: It opens up coastal communities to trade, tourism and jobs.

column2: A north–south corridor from Sokoto to the Atlantic coast at Badagry, with about ₦1.11tn spent so far.
column3: Northern farm produce can reach southern markets and ports faster and more cheaply.

column1: When did the Abuja light rail return to service?
column2: In May 2024, after years of standing idle.
column3: Abuja commuters now have a cheaper alternative to traffic jams.

column1: How much did rail passenger numbers grow?
column2: 689,263 passengers in Q2 2024, up 45.38% from the same period in 2023, with rail cargo also rising.
column3: More people choosing trains means safer, cheaper travel.

column1: Which South-South/South-East rail service resumed in 2024?
column2: Passenger services on the Port Harcourt–Aba railway.
column3: It links traders in Aba with Port Harcourt by rail.

column1: What rail link to Niger Republic secured funding?
column2: The Kano–Maradi railway secured about $1.3 billion in financing arrangements (March 2024).
column3: It strengthens cross-border trade for northern businesses.

column1: How many roads did FERMA make motorable in 2025?
column2: 1,655.89 km of roads made motorable, 200.82 km maintained and 31,574 m² of potholes patched (agency-reported).
column3: Fixing existing roads matters as much as building new ones.

column1: What is the National Single Window?
column2: A single digital platform (launched 16 April 2024) for all trade documents and approvals at the ports.
column3: Faster cargo clearance means fewer delays and lower costs for importers and exporters.
